correctness.rationale: From the actual 18-vertex LCF construction, independent check enumerated 27 edges and cardinality-4/5/6 face counts (801,756,348). A fresh sparse F3 chain elimination (not merely acceptance of recorded stdout) gave rank(d4)=472, rank(d5)=274, dim H4=10. The signed rotation on oriented five-vertex simplices yields induced ten-dimensional R with ranks R-I=6 and (R-I)^2=2 and (R-I)^3=0, hence two J3 blocks, two J2 blocks and no J1. The attached integral Morse checker source supplies an explicit acyclic 1292-pair matching, critical cells 1,11,1 in dimensions 0,4,5 and primitive d5 vector, consistent with H4(Z)=Z^10; original script was inspected but integral matching was not rerun independently. All claims concern the fixed finite graph, not a general Pappus-family theorem.
